description: WHEN: BEFORE investigating a problem, designing a change or answering a question about how a client's D365 F&O works: check whether it was already solved. Returns the lessons learned that best match, with their problem, cause and solution. Triggers: 'did we already see this', 'a-t-on déjà eu ce problème', 'known issue', 'leçons apprises', 'how did we fix'. Pass the D365 objects involved in `objects` when you know them: they weigh most. A result marked UNVALIDATED has not been reviewed by an administrator: use it as a lead and verify it. A lesson records a past case: confirm the cause is the same before applying its solution, and say which lesson you used.

objects.description: Optional: comma-separated D365 objects involved, e.g. 'SalesLine, CustInvoiceJour'.

query.description: The symptom, error message or question, in plain words.

name: lesson_search
